articles.title: Strategy Bitcoin treasury hits breakeven point as BTC price passes $77K
articles.description: Bitcoin gains 20% in two days as Strategy sees its BTC treasury climb out of the red.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $608M as Ether ETFs see largest inflow since October
articles.description: Bitcoin ETF inflows pushed August’s total to a 2026 high of $2.07 billion as Bitcoin traded above $75,000 and Ether climbed to $2,357.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: South Korean lawmakers seek expanded FIU powers over unregistered crypto firms
articles.description: The proposal would let the FIU investigate suspected violations and refer unregistered crypto operators directly to law enforcement.

articles.title: MANTRA token sinks 18% to record low amid blockchain halt
articles.description: The token recovered to about $0.0044 after setting a new low, while exchanges paused deposits and withdrawals from the halted MANTRA Chain.

articles.title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
articles.description: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks above 200-day moving average for first time since November
articles.description: The BTC price reclaimed its 200-day moving average for the first time in nine months as its rally gained momentum after the US Treasury expanded its bond buybacks.

articles.title: CFTC chair says agency will move forward on crypto regulation if CLARITY fails
articles.description: Michael Selig said at a meeting of the Innovation Advisory Committee that he had directed CFTC staff to explore developer protections and other crypto-related policies.

articles.title: Binance opens crypto trading to AI agents with user-set controls
articles.description: Binance’s Agent OS lets AI agents access market data, execute trades and make payments while giving users control over permissions and account access.

articles.title: US debt tops $40T stoking debate on what it means for Bitcoin
articles.description: Analysts say the $40 trillion debt milestone could bolster Bitcoin’s long-term case, even as Treasury yields, dollar strength and liquidity remain key near-term drivers.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pour billions into AI as capex outpaces revenue 15-to-1
articles.description: Nine public miners generated $341 million from AI and HPC operations in the first half of 2026 after spending more than $5 billion on capital assets.

articles.title: Most Americans say the Trump family’s crypto investments are not ‘appropriate’: Poll
articles.description: A new poll showed 63% of 1,166 Americans varied sharply along partisan lines, with a majority of Republicans saying it was appropriate for Trump and his family to invest in crypto.

articles.title: Optimism moves 546.9M OP from future airdrops to ecosystem growth fund
articles.description: The governance vote redirects tokens previously reserved for user airdrops toward partnerships, incentives and Optimism’s growing institutional push.

articles.title: Bitcoin price reaches $72.5K as US issues ‘Economic D-Day’ threat to Iran
articles.description: Bitcoin saw new multimonth highs above $72,500 even as US stocks cooled amid US threats of “economic warfare” with Iran.

articles.title: MiCA cracks down on USDT in Europe... but no one else cares
articles.description: USDT is disappearing from regulated European platforms, but there is little sign that it has resulted in weakening global demand for Tether.

articles.title: Bitdeer signs $400M AI cloud computing deal for Malaysia facility
articles.description: Bitdeer expects revenue from the five-year agreement to begin in early 2027 as it builds toward 350 megawatts of AI cloud capacity by 2028.

articles.title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
articles.description: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $517M in largest one-day inflow since early May
articles.description: Investors have poured more than $1 billion into US spot Bitcoin ETFs this week as BTC neared $72,000 and Ether climbed 19% to about $2,286 on Thursday.

articles.title: Crypto generated about 1% of Webull’s record $198M Q2 revenue
articles.description: While Webull reported a record $198 million in second-quarter revenue, cryptocurrency trading only generated about $2.25 million of the quarter’s revenue stream.

articles.title: Crypto short liquidations pass $3B mark as Bitcoin price nears $72K
articles.description: Bitcoin approached $72,000 in a second day of upside as crypto short liquidations passed $3.1 billion.

articles.title: GnosisDAO approves Gnosis Chain for Ethereum Economic Zone
articles.description: Gnosis Chain was approved to transition to an EEZ rollup, enabling it to settle directly to Ethereum rather than continue with an independent validator set.

articles.title: BitGo Korea secures VASP registration for institutional crypto custody
articles.description: Regulators reportedly accepted BitGo Korea’s registration on Tuesday, two days before stricter VASP entry requirements took effect.

articles.title: HYPE jumps 20% as Trump signals legal US path for Hyperliquid
articles.description: HYPE reached $72 after Trump said the CFTC was pursuing compliant US access for Hyperliquid, though no formal regulatory plan has been released.

articles.title: Rushed CLARITY Act vote could set legislation back, Gallego warns
articles.description: Senator Ruben Gallego said the White House has not provided point-by-point feedback on a bipartisan ethics proposal as a September vote approaches.

articles.title: Bitcoin.com integrates UAE-registered US dollar stablecoin into self-custodial wallet
articles.description: The integration expands access to USDU, the UAE’s first central bank-registered US dollar stablecoin, as it builds distribution beyond institutional channels.

articles.title: Trump pushes for CLARITY Act passage alongside crypto leaders
articles.description: Donald Trump spoke from the White House on Wednesday, urging the Senate to pass a crypto market structure bill to keep the country “ahead of China.”

articles.title: Crypto PAC notches primary wins, but loses $2M Florida race
articles.description: A Fairshake spokesperson said that the PAC was “just getting started“ on its expenditures as part of efforts to fill US Congress with lawmakers friendly to the crypto industry.

articles.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
articles.description: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.

articles.title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
articles.description: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

articles.title: StanChart, HSBC execute first live transaction on Swift blockchain ledger
articles.description: The transaction connected the banks’ separate tokenized deposit systems through Swift’s ledger, marking a step toward interoperable, 24/7 cross-border payments.
